topics.label: Lecture introduction and learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer introduces the core themes of the lecture and outlines the intended learning outcomes.

topics.label: Clonal selection and epigenetic changes in pre-malignant tissues
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore how Darwinian natural selection acting on somatic mutations and epigenetic alterations drives clonal succession in early tissue transformation.

topics.label: Cell of origin and the cancer stem cell model
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how normal tissue hierarchies, stem cell properties, and cell-of-origin differences influence tumor initiation across leukemia and intestinal crypt models.

topics.label: Microenvironmental and inflammatory promotion of tumor growth
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how extrinsic environmental factors, chronic inflammation, and supportive stromal interactions cooperate with cellular mutations to permit and sustain malignant growth.

topics.label: Technologies for investigating tumor evolution and spatial architecture
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic addresses the experimental and computational techniques used to map clonal lineage, transcriptional states, and spatial interactions in human tissue specimens.

topics.label: Synthesis of cancer evolution and microenvironmental cooperation
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic synthesizes the lecture's concepts into an integrated multifactorial model of cancer development governed by cellular fitness, cell of origin, and environmental context.

topics.label: Lecture closing
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer concludes the session and previews the topic of the next lecture.
